value.rationale: Gives a complete natural exact discrete symmetry classification for all irrational Sturmian cyclic first-difference lifts, including nonlinearly recurrent/non-substitutive slopes. Its sharp loss of all sufficiently long palindromes for k>=3 contrasts with the binary setting, and the exact automorphism group answers a genuine finite-extension structural problem beyond general virtually-cyclic group bounds.
